# OCRT pure-water absorption temperature coefficient psi_T(lambda)
# Formula: a_w(lambda,T) = a_w(lambda,20C) + psi_T(lambda)*(T-20C)
# Units: wavelength [nm], psi_T [m^-1 degC^-1]
# Primary reference: Rottgers, McKee & Utschig (2014), Optics Express 22, 25093-25108, DOI 10.1364/OE.22.025093
# Numeric source: R. Rottgers/HZG WOPP purewater_abs_coefficients_v3.dat (Nov 2016), 2-nm nodes
# Source repository/blob: eoplus/rho data-raw/purewater_abs_coefficients_v3.dat, blob 6fd39b0ce2a087a68c97dc3950e88376ce9d14b4
# OCRT spectral policy:
#   330-440 nm: psi_T = 0 exactly. Rottgers et al. report the coefficient is not significantly different from zero in 300-440 nm.
#   441-1100 nm: PCHIP internal interpolation of the WOPP 2-nm family, using an explicit zero anchor at 440 nm.
#   442-1100 nm even-numbered source nodes are preserved exactly; no runtime extrapolation is required in 330-1100 nm.
# T_ref = 20 degC. Negative psi_T values are physical and are retained.
/end_header
